notes.title: Skykipelago is coming to Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[b]Devlog for Skykipelago – A Chill Building Strategy Game in the Sky[/b]

Hello, Sky Builders!

Long time no see! While we were away, we were hard at work to finally bring you a [b]playable Skykipelago demo[/b].

[b]When?[/b] Pretty soon! Steam Next Fest starts on October 14th, with Press Preview on October 4th. We plan to have the demo live by then.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42948741/4c8c8f1fb29f5fbb609c41a9d007c41565d18a2d.gif[/img]

[b]What's in the demo?[/b] The demo will contain two modes:

[*] [b]Points Mode[/b], where your goal is to collect as many points as possible. Some buildings like to have neighbors, some prefer... well... no neighbors (I'm looking at you, Hermit Hut). Pay attention to the needs of individual buildings to maximize your points.

[*] [b]Happiness Mode[/b], where your goal is to make as many buildings happy as possible. Every building has a specific happiness threshold. Once it meets that threshold, a building becomes happy. How do you achieve this? By placing neighbors that the building likes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42948741/c10675a1bf301cada5796d5b77ecf7dd5dcff569.gif[/img]

Of course, you can ignore all those points and objectives and simply build a sky city of your dreams. Just you, your city and its bear citizens and the chill atmosphere. It's up to you – no pressure.

We're so excited to bring you the sky-city-building experience we've been working on for so long. Hope to hear from you soon!

[b]Have a happy rest of the week,
Cheers![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1980460/Skykipelago/

notes.title: Skykipelago Devlog 15.03.2024
notes.notes:
[b]Devlog for Skykipelago - A Chill Building Strategy Game in the Sky[/b]

Hello, sky builders!

This week, our focus has been on refining the models for two pivotal structures: the Evolution Tower and the Happiness Tower. Now, you might be wondering: 'wait, you can place towers in Skykipelago?'. Well, you can place plenty other buildings. The towers, however, serve a unique function.

Both the Evolution Tower and the Happiness Tower grow as you skillfully expand your city. By reaching higher tower levels, you'll be rewarded with platforms to expand your city, more buildings, and a hefty points bonus.

Initially, our efforts were centered on simply updating the tower models...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42948741/874041594e57d7d11bd13c6de619e16ad161f478.png[/img]

However, as development progressed, it became apparent that something was missing. Thus, we made the decision to incorporate dedicated platforms for these towers, ensuring they wouldn't encroach upon valuable island space.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42948741/10cf0c1f0ccbf2903a1dc0efa28cc6557c9d335c.png[/img]

And now, presenting the final version:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42948741/7bec96824c6503ec5b37d2caa6dd910b27855504.png[/img]

What do you think? We'd love to hear your thoughts in the comments!

[b]Wishing you all a fantastic weekend.
Cheers![/b]

notes.title: Skykipelago Devlog 03.11.2023
notes.notes:
[b]Devlog for Skykipelago - A Chill Building Strategy Game in the Sky[/b]
Greetings, sky builders! We're thrilled to share the latest updates and features of Skykipelago, the serene and creative city-building game set in the clouds. Let's dive into what's new and what you can expect from our world of floating islands.

[b]Overview:[/b] Skykipelago is all about crafting happy little cities in the sky. Set on a collection of colorful islands suspended high above the ground, your mission is to care for your buildings' happiness, evolve your structures, and expand onto cliff sides when you're feeling daring. It's the ultimate chill building experience, with intuitive gameplay that lets you focus on creating your dream sky metropolis.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42948741/06d35a2c58ad7c0e5a830e64c978ad2d0c96c7e9.gif[/img]

[b]Opportunity Building:[/b] In Skykipelago, we believe in equal opportunity building. Whether it's a horizontal or vertical surface, the skies offer limitless possibilities. Show off your engineering skills by building your dream city.

[b]Happy Little Buildings:[/b] The key to prosperity in Skykipelago lies in the happiness of your buildings. Choose your building locations wisely to create satisfying point combos, making it easier than ever to expand your little city in the sky.

[b]Evolve Your Buildings:[/b] Some buildings are never finished growing, and in Skykipelago, it's up to you to choose their destiny. Will they remain the same, or will you make them much more powerful? You decide!

[b]Delve into the Skykipelago Storyline:[/b] For those who love a challenge and a narrative to follow, Skykipelago offers a Campaign Mode. Assume the role of U'vatar, a powerful guardian tasked with reconstructing the prosperous Skykipelago and guiding your people toward a bright future. It's not just about building; it's about saving your people and the land they call home.
And remember, in the world of Skykipelago, let your creativity soar and build the city of your dreams, no matter which way the wind blows. Happy building, fellow architects of the sky!
Stay tuned for more updates, gameplay teasers, and the official release date announcement!
